title: Air Conditioning — Zone Controller Operational Software Standard ZC_OPS_V4.1 Data Load
abstract: Data load of the zone controller operational software standard that limits pull-down authority, predicts duct temperature and removes the latching trim air protection, on aircraft delivered before the load was cut into production.

sections.planning_reason: Operators flying out of hot-and-high airfields have reported the trim air system latching off during the climb, leaving the cabin on pack outlet temperature for the remainder of the sector. Eighty-one events were recorded in eighteen months and the hardware was found correct in every investigated case. The behaviour is a control law characteristic and is corrected entirely in software, with no hardware change and no kit.
sections.description: The operational load is replaced by software LA1R2B6A257, which limits pull-down authority as a function of duct inlet temperature, adds a first-order duct temperature prediction that throttles the trim air valve before the protection threshold is reached, and replaces the protection latch by a reset that arms after ninety seconds below threshold. The trim air actuator D2160117909333, the zone controller valve D2160128690391, the manifold kit D2160120235977 and the controller clamp QUI339334-79 are all unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Put the aircraft on ground power and make the air conditioning system safe for maintenance. Get access to the zone controllers and record the software part numbers currently loaded on each. Connect the portable data loader at the data loading panel. Load the operational software LA1R2B6A257 to the first controller and wait for the load to be confirmed. Repeat for the second controller. Power cycle both controllers and confirm that each reports the new part number. Load the previous parameter standard LB8R1DDEAAF if the aircraft does not already carry it, as the operational load will not run without it. Do the zone controller operational test of AMM-T-21-60-12-700-001-A, including a trim air valve authority check on at least two zones. Confirm that the maintenance message list is clear. Record the embodiment and update the aircraft software configuration list.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to TITAN-88 aircraft up to and including MSN T00142. Aircraft from MSN T00145 onwards left the line with the load already applied. Both zone controllers on an aircraft must carry the same standard; a mixed pair is not permitted and will raise a configuration mismatch message.
sections.material_note: No kit and no hardware. The software is supplied through the operator's normal media distribution route and is available from the effective date of this Service Bulletin. The previous standard should be retained on the operator's media until the new standard has been in service for thirty days.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next line maintenance opportunity, or within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
